sites.name: host_capacity_gate
sites.semantic: remaining capacity computes 4-occupied and forwards r8d=4

sites.name: host_index_allocator
sites.semantic: host+0x100 flags scan compares ecx with 4; a second table has r14d<4

sites.name: host_confirmed_peer_sender
sites.semantic: session+0x20/session+0x40 confirmed-peer tables are stride 0x38 with four-slot loops

sites.name: client_confirmed_peer_insert
sites.semantic: client+0xc8 count appends client+0xd0 records with 0x20 stride; fifth append reaches +0x150

sites.name: player_creation_gate
sites.semantic: player index at owner-relative +0x163ac is rejected when >=4

required_lifecycle_paths.name: host_peer_cleanup
required_lifecycle_paths.required: clear sidecar peer record and release owner reservation

required_lifecycle_paths.name: client_confirmed_peer_remove
required_lifecycle_paths.required: remove by owner key and compact only logical map

required_lifecycle_paths.name: client_confirmed_peer_reset
required_lifecycle_paths.required: reset all eight records without touching adjacent +0x150 fields

sidecar_contract.owner_key: host/session or client owner pointer, never peer ordinal
sidecar_contract.record_storage: 8 confirmed-peer records and 8 client records, separately owned

blockers: Host capacity and index allocation are independent four-slot paths.
Client append has a four-record in-object footprint; record five overlaps adjacent live fields.
Player creation rejects index 4 and higher before resource/roster creation.
Cleanup, migration, dispatcher binding, and receiver lifetime are not closed by fixed-site bytes alone.
